configuration_profile: direct HPACK Huffman decoder plus a build-only wrapper for the static HPACK integer decoder
allocator_mode: no heap allocation by nginx; harness-owned bounded output buffer
justification: The existing HTTP/1 adapter never supplies HTTP/2 header blocks, so HPACK decoding was unreachable.
state: Every input is decoded both in one shot and in input-controlled fragments; status, final state and decoded bytes must match. The same bytes are passed to the integer decoder with HPACK prefixes 4, 5, 6 and 7 bits.
known_limitations: This target covers HPACK byte-level primitives, not the dynamic header table or request-header semantic validation.
HEADERS and CONTINUATION frame sequencing is outside this target.
The integer decoder exposure patch is applied only to the isolated instrumented build copy.

scopes.contract: Decode HPACK Huffman bytes incrementally and reject invalid or incomplete encodings on the final fragment.
scopes.preconditions: State starts at zero and the output capacity is at least twice the encoded length plus one byte.

scopes.contract: Decode HPACK prefix integers with bounded continuation octets and input accounting.
scopes.preconditions: At least one byte is available for non-empty calls; logical frame length is modeled separately.
